newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Living to buy new facility.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Living to buy new facility.

text.p: Integrated Living Communities Inc on Wednesday said it will buy a 220-bed assisted-living facility in Sun City, Calif.
Terms were not disclosed. The purchase will be closed by early June and will be financed with bank credit, the company said.

The purchase will be Integrated Living's eighth acquisition this year, the company said. It operates 24 facilities in 10 states. The company has signed letters of intent for the purchase of 14 other facilities in five states with more than 1,400 beds.
